suggested_experiment_name: COBE/FIRAS (axion-photon conversion in halos, CMB spectral distortions)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 2
notes: Paper (arXiv:2405.08059) is primarily a sensitivity forecast for axion-induced patchy screening with Planck/unWISE and CMB-S4 (projections reaching ~3e-12 GeV^-1 and beyond). However, it also derives an actual NEW exclusion from COBE/FIRAS spectral distortion data (Fig. 2, blue region, stated at 99% CL - encoded here as 0.95 since 0.99 is not an allowed value): CMB monopole spectral distortions from photon-axion conversion in halos exclude g_agamma >~ 1e-9 GeV^-1 over the accessible axion mass range 2e-13 to 3e-12 eV. No numerical table is provided; data points are an approximate flat bound based on the text statement 'spectral distortions can only probe couplings as small as 10^-9 GeV^-1' over the paper's stated mass validity range. The pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton is incorrect - the paper explicitly constrains the axion-photon coupling g_agamma (the dark photon case is 'Paper I', a separate publication). Axion is assumed to be a negligible fraction of dark matter, so no local DM density assumption applies. If the forecast curves (Planck/CMB-S4 sensitivities down to ~3e-12 and ~4e-13 GeV^-1) are desired instead, those would be projections. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 36)) | Vision: Boundary traced from the blue 'FIRAS' shaded region in Figure 2 (m_a vs g_agamma plane). The region is excluded at 99% CL per the caption (reported here as 0.95 since only 0.90/0.95 allowed; actual CL is 0.99). The FIRAS blob is U-shaped: floor at g~9e-10 GeV^-1 around m_a~5e-13 eV, rising to the top of the plotted range (~3e-8 GeV^-1) at m_a~1.4e-13 and ~2.4e-12 eV. Consistent with paper text: spectral distortions probe couplings down to ~1e-9 GeV^-1, and the method has a natural mass cutoff at m_a~3e-12 eV. This is not a dark-matter search, so no DM density assumed.
